recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. The seed request remains satisfied by current source, and the only remaining current-spec defect found during reconciliation was the stale module link that could misdirect readers away from EventDefinition.
issue_request: FHIR-13715 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-core request to create an EventDefinition resource for reusable event definitions in subscriptions, plan definitions, and related artifacts, and to expand TriggerDefinition for subscription use cases.
initial_application: The Jira resolution says the change was pre-applied and cites SVN revisions 12177, 12253, 12254, and 12259. Git history shows f08b464764 added the draft EventDefinition resource, examples, introduction, fhir.ini registration, and TriggerDefinition source updates on 2017-06-29, with follow-up EventDefinition clarification commits in July 2017.
additional_context: Current source registers EventDefinition as an active resource and assigns it to CDS. Adjacent STU3 issues FHIR-13716 and FHIR-13717 cover TriggerDefinition naming and data-changed support and are already represented on the combined branch. Later R6 issues FHIR-41372, FHIR-53316, and FHIR-53414 refined the EventDefinition/SubscriptionTopic relationship, ultimately leaving EventDefinition undeprecated with examples and trigger guidance.
reconciliation: Changed source/clinicalreasoning-module.html so the Clinical Reasoning module index row for EventDefinition links to eventdefinition.html instead of evidence.html. The resource definition and TriggerDefinition datatype did not require structural changes.
source_changes: source/clinicalreasoning-module.html: corrected the EventDefinition row link from evidence.html to eventdefinition.html.
